name: opening_drive_reversal_001
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, the post-auction first 25-35 minutes produce a sharp directional burst of 30-80 spot points as gap-fill program trades, institutional TWAP launches, and retail market orders hit a book that was thinly pre-positioned overnight. When this opening drive stalls — signaled by price reaching 0.3%+ deviation from session VWAP, the 30-second RSI(6) reading entering extreme territory (≤15 or ≥85), and a visible rejection wick consuming ≥35% of the bar range — VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms begin counter-flow aggressively since they are getting fills materially better/worse than their session-VWAP benchmark. At 5-second resolution we enter the moment the exhaustion wick forms, capturing the first 10-18 spot point mean-reversion leg within 30-90 seconds before the full 1-minute reversal confirmation is visible.

indicators.name: session_vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(typical_price * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset each day
indicators.purpose: Cumulative measure — no scaling needed. VWAP is the intraday fair value anchor used by NIFTY-benchmarked institutional algorithms; deviation from it measures the overshoot depth and also determines when algorithmic buy/sell programs activate.

indicators.name: vwap_dev
indicators.purpose: Fractional deviation from VWAP. Threshold of 0.3% (tunable 0.2-0.6%) corresponds to 69-138 NIFTY spot points at 23000 — the range where opening drive overshoots reliably attract institutional VWAP counter-flow. Tighter than original's 0.5% because the index is smoother than individual stocks and hits 0.3% more frequently.

indicators.name: rsi_6
indicators.purpose: 30-second RSI — fast enough to detect exhaustion within 1-2 minutes of the drive starting. Original used RSI(2) on 1-min bars (ultra-fast by design). At 5s bars, RSI(2) is pure noise (only 2 candles); RSI(6)=30s preserves the ultra-fast exhaustion detection intent while smoothing individual-bar spikes. NOT the standard 14-period RSI — we need the signal before the drive reverses, not after.

indicators.name: wick_down_ratio
indicators.purpose: Lower wick as fraction of total bar range. No lookback scaling — wick geometry is bar-local. Measures whether sellers were rejected intrabar, indicating resting buy orders absorbed the final flush. ≥0.35 means at least 35% of the bar's range is wicked below the body.

indicators.name: wick_up_ratio
indicators.purpose: Upper wick as fraction of total bar range. Symmetric to wick_down_ratio for bearish setups. Detects buyers getting rejected at the top of the up-drive bar — intrabar evidence that supply absorbed the bid.

indicators.name: rel_vol_60
indicators.purpose: Relative volume vs 5-minute rolling average. Original used SMA(volume, 20) on 1-min = 20-minute window. At 5s bars we use 60 bars = 5 minutes, shorter than original's 20-min equivalent (240 bars), because in the opening window the volume baseline is itself elevated — comparing against the immediate 5-min window detects a surge WITHIN the opening rush, filtering for the peak exhaustion candle rather than just any elevated-volume bar.

indicators.name: vwap_slope_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute VWAP change as fraction of close (vwap_slope_60 / close). Detects trending vs flat VWAP regimes. Original used vwap_slope_5 on 1-min = 5-min window, which is the same time window. We only fade when VWAP is near-flat (< 0.2% change in 5 min), avoiding counter-trend entries when the drive is becoming a sustained trend.

conditions: rsi_6 <= rsi_os_threshold (≤ 15, severely oversold on 30s RSI)
wick_down_ratio >= wick_threshold (≥ 0.35, lower wick absorbs sellers)
rel_vol_60 >= vol_threshold (≥ 1.5, volume surge confirming exhaustion bar)
abs(vwap_slope_60 / close) <= 0.002 (VWAP not in strong trend)
close > open (current 5s bar is bullish — reversal has started)
buy_ce.confirmation: close > open on the signal bar — first bullish 5s print after exhaustion

conditions: rsi_6 >= rsi_ob_threshold (≥ 85, severely overbought on 30s RSI)
wick_up_ratio >= wick_threshold (≥ 0.35, upper wick absorbs buyers)
rel_vol_60 >= vol_threshold (≥ 1.5, volume surge confirming exhaustion bar)
abs(vwap_slope_60 / close) <= 0.002 (VWAP not in strong trend)
close < open (current 5s bar is bearish — reversal has started)
buy_pe.confirmation: close < open on the signal bar — first bearish 5s print after exhaustion

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points = ~8 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. An opening drive that reverses does not retrace more than 8 spot points within 30-90s if the exhaustion thesis is correct; if it does, the drive is resuming (not reversing), and we must exit immediately. 4 pts chosen because the typical reversal move is 10-18 spot pts (5-9 option pts), giving ~1:1.75 R:R.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option points = ~14 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. Opening drive reversals on NIFTY from 0.3%+ VWAP deviations typically cover 15-25 spot points in the first 30-90 seconds as VWAP-benchmarked algorithms absorb the counter-flow. Targeting 14 pts captures ~60% of the typical first leg at 1:1.75 R:R, leaving room for time stop to kick in on weaker reversals.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 10:00 IST (session_end_minutes = 600) — only trade the opening drive window

filters.vix_filter: none — opening reversal works in both low/high VIX as the drive overshoot is a structural feature of opening auction mechanics
filters.time_filter: strict 09:20-10:00 only — opening drive exhaustion is exclusively an opening-window phenomenon; later in the day VWAP deviations of this size indicate trending, not reversal
filters.volume_filter: rel_vol_60 >= 1.5 — exhaustion bars must show a volume spike, confirming the drive consumed available supply/demand
filters.trend_filter: abs(vwap_slope_60 / close) <= 0.002 — skip if 5-min VWAP is trending (drift > 0.2%), indicating the drive is a sustained directional move
filters.spread_filter: none — limit orders at 5s close prices

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium-low — structural feature of opening auction mechanics, but opening drive amplitude can shrink in low-gap sessions reducing signal frequency

adaptation_notes: Original traded top-150 NIFTY200 stocks on 1-min bars, 09:20-10:15, with cross-sectional screening. Converted to NIFTY index directly — the opening drive is more predictable on the index (smoother, less gappy, driven by institutional program flow rather than single-stock events). Key changes: (1) RSI period compressed from RSI(2)@1min to RSI(6)@5s — preserves ultra-fast exhaustion intent at 5s frequency; (2) VWAP deviation threshold tightened from 0.5% to 0.3% because NIFTY index reaches 0.3% deviation ~5-8x/session vs stocks that may move 1-2%; (3) volume window compressed from 20-min to 5-min rolling avg to detect the peak exhaustion bar within the opening burst; (4) session end tightened from 10:15 to 10:00 since the drive overshoot is most reliable in the first 45 minutes; (5) hold time compressed from 5-12 minutes to 30-90 seconds — at 5s we enter the moment the exhaustion wick forms rather than waiting for the next 1-min bar.
weaknesses: Low-gap or sideways opening sessions produce shallow drives that do not reach the 0.3% VWAP threshold, reducing trade frequency to zero.
RSI(6) at 5-second frequency can produce false extremes during micro-volatility spikes unrelated to the opening drive structure.
The 30-90 second hold window may be too tight to capture the full mean-reversion on slow-reverting days — time stop fires before target is reached.
VWAP is less meaningful in the first 5-10 minutes (too few bars) — late session_start (09:20) partially mitigates this but early VWAP is still noisy.

_source.original_stop: signal bar extreme or 0.45% from entry
